correctness.rationale: Minimum number four is prior. A nonempty white fort disjoint from the initial black set is exactly a stalled forcing obstruction. Inspected 16-state transfer tracks two-bit adjacent column fort masks and a marked flag for a NONEMPTY fort, avoiding false empty paths. Independently reconstructed the marked Boolean transition and verified T0^5=T0^6=T0^7 for all sixteen states (225 marked reachable pairs); hence all zero gaps longer than five truncate without altering the existence of a fort. Inspected script exhausts exactly 25,013 compressed mask-gap words of total weight <=4, tests all five explicit orbits, and asserts no smaller forcing sets. Separate independent brute forcing directly enumerated all 6,376 four-sets across n=6,7,8,9, matching 13n, degree spectrum and exchange connectivity; no experiment alone proves n unbounded. The local support bound and integer-line symbolic degree check prove the 12,8,8,8,5 orbit degrees for all n>=14; direct cyclic exceptional n6..13 are claimed in source and code inspected. Sum degrees gives 48n edges and orbit-to-square paths establish connectedness.
